issues.jp_before: 将来[しょうらい]の仕事[しごと]は、早[はや]く{決[き]めたほうがいいですよ|tr-kimaru}。
issues.problem: With topic は and no agent, distractor 決まったほうがいいですよ ('it's better if it gets decided early') is natural.
issues.action: Changed は to を so the intransitive distractor is ungrammatical; updated why.

issues.jp_before: 次[つぎ]の担当[たんとう]は、じゃんけんで{決[き]めましょう|tr-kimaru}。
issues.problem: With は, distractors 決まります / 決まりました ('will be / was decided by rock-paper-scissors') are natural Japanese; only the English mood excluded them.
issues.action: Changed は to を; updated why.

issues.jp_before: 子[こ]どもたちの名前[なまえ]は、夫婦[ふうふ]で話[はな]し合[あ]って{決[き]めました|tr-kimaru}。
issues.problem: With は, distractor 決まりました ('was decided after the couple talked') is natural.

issues.jp_before: 昨日[きのう]、信号[しんごう]が赤[あか]から青[あお]に{変[か]わりました|tr-kimaru}。
issues.problem: Unnatural content ('yesterday the signal changed'); one distractor tested only tense.
issues.action: Rewrote as 信号が赤から青に{変わったら}、渡りましょう with distractors 変えたら / 変えれば / 変わらなければ.

issues.jp_before: 来週[らいしゅう]から、会議[かいぎ]の時間[じかん]を{変[か]えます|tr-kimaru}。
issues.problem: Distractor 変えました is natural ('we have changed the meeting time, effective next week').
issues.action: Replaced 変えました with 変わっています (ungrammatical with を).

issues.jp_before: この町[まち]の様子[ようす]は、十年[じゅうねん]前[まえ]から少[すこ]しも{変[か]わっていません|tr-kimaru}。
issues.problem: With 様子は as topic, distractor 変えていません ('(we) have not changed the town's look') is possible; English 'since ten years ago' unnatural.
issues.action: Rewrote as この町は…変わっていません so 変えていません lacks an object; English 'in the last ten years'; updated why.

issues.jp_before: 駅[えき]の前[まえ]で、募金[ぼきん]のためにお金[かね]を{集[あつ]めています|tr-kimaru}。
issues.problem: 募金のためにお金を集める is redundant; English 'for a fund' is unnatural.
issues.action: Rewrote as 寄付のお金を集めています, English 'They are collecting donations in front of the station.'

issues.jp_before: かばんの中[なか]を探[さが]しても、鍵[かぎ]が{見[み]つかりません|tr-kimaru}。
issues.problem: English 'Even though I search in my bag, my key doesn't turn up' is awkward.
issues.action: English changed to 'Even when I look through my bag, I can't find my key.'
